_comment: Accepted ZAP alerts, applied before the scan. newLevel: -1 false positive, 0 info, 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. Each entry needs a justification, an owner and a review date; the justification is logged on every run.

filters.justification: Double-submit CSRF token: the console reads this cookie to echo it in X-CSRF-Token, so it cannot be HttpOnly. It holds no session authority (Secure, SameSite=Strict, HMAC-signed). Session cookies are HttpOnly (checked by the Playwright suite).

The console's forms are submitted by JavaScript to the API with the X-CSRF-Token header (double-submit, enforced by the API's CSRF guard). A native POST to a Next.js page has no side effect, so no hidden form token is needed.
